IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives O'Brien, Strow, Ericks, Ahern, Rodne, Woods, McCune and Sump

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing discovery provisions for criminal cases.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to materials furnished to an attorney pursuant todiscovery in a criminal case; and adding a new section to chapter 10.58RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 10.58 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any materials furnished to an attorney pursuant to discovery in acriminal case shall remain in the exclusive custody of the attorney andbe used only for the purposes of conducting the party's side of thecase, and shall be subject to such other terms and conditions as thecourt may provide.
